@@info: Prefer translating in your browser? Fink edits messages/uk.json directly — no code or git:
This file is the offline alternative.
Keys that exist in <en> but not in <uk>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with uk translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/uk.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
Plurals — uk uses the forms: one, few, many, other. "other" is required.
(add "plural": "total" to count another input instead of {count}).
Inside a sentence, # is the number: "Read {count, plural, one {# band} other {# bands}}"
An exact number like "=0": "No bands" beats the forms above.
equalizer_filter_list_import_unreadable: The file could not be read

equalizer_filter_list_delete_all_body.one: This deletes the {count} band in the list. You can bring it back with undo.
equalizer_filter_list_delete_all_body.other: This deletes all {count} bands, including any set for one ear only. You can bring them back with undo.

equalizer_autoeq_select_source_and_targe: Please select both a source device and target curve.
equalizer_autoeq_data_not_found: Source or target data not found.
equalizer_autoeq_no_response_data: Could not retrieve frequency response data.
equalizer_player_device_eq: {device} applies the EQ, so this player leaves it off.
equalizer_player_device_eq_unwritten: It doesn't hold your latest changes yet.
equalizer_player_device_ask: Listening through {device}? Then the EQ is applied twice.
equalizer_player_device_eq_there: Leave the EQ to the device
graph_uploader_no_data: No valid data points found in the file
graph_uploader_too_large: {name} is larger than {size} MB and was not loaded.
graph_uploader_too_many: {count} files selected. Pick at most {limit} at a time.
share_button_manual_copy: Your browser blocked copying. Copy the link below yourself.
misc_panel_theme_hint_following: Following your device's light or dark setting. Switching overrides it.
misc_panel_theme_hint_resume: This matches your device's setting, so the page follows it again.
misc_panel_single_key_shortcuts_key_hint: Keys 1 to 4 switch panels and \ holds the EQ bypass.
misc_panel_single_key_shortcuts_off_hint: Turn this off if they get in the way of typing or voice control.
misc_panel_single_key_shortcuts_mod_hint: Ctrl+Z and the other shortcuts with a modifier key stay on.
eq_hold_on_device: Holding \ can't switch the EQ while {device} is applying it.
equalizer_device_peq_network_ip_hint: An IP address or a .local name, with a port if it needs one
device_peq_network_host_invalid: Enter only the device's IP address (192.168.1.20) or its .local name (wiim.local), with an optional port. No http://, paths or spaces.
device_peq_network_host_public: That is a public hostname. Use the device's IP address or its .local name.
device_peq_network_host_port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
device_peq_error_network_blocked: The browser couldn't reach the device. Check that it is on and on this network, and that this site is allowed to connect to devices on your local network. A site served over HTTPS can't reach a device that only answers over HTTP.
